text:
[LSER.16.2.1] `sum` / `count` / `mean` are **exact** on `all_time` (`SeriesBackendWelfordEwma`),
`sliding` (the raw-sample ring buffer `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` at O(window·rate) state, [LSER.18.2]),
and `sample` (the `SeriesBackendReservoir` reservoir). Their `tumbling` form has no exact per-bucket
backing in v1 and is rejected (§ [LSER.18], [LSER.14.4]). No accuracy
phrase exists.
